newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land offers 108 flats for sale.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land offers 108 flats for sale.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said it would offer a total 108 residential units from its three residential developments in New Territories.
A company spokesman said 80 units, with size ranging 505 to 724 square feet, of Metro City in Tseung Kwan O would be offered at an average price of HK$6,695 per square foot.

He said another 20 units of Grandville Garden in Shatin's Tai Wei would put for sale at an average HK$5,910 per square foot. The flats range from 826 to 1,118 square feet per unit. Another eight units from Tolo Place, size ranging 1,204 to 1,223 square feet, in Tai Po will be offered at HK$7,580 per square feet, the spokesman said.
Registration for potential buyers will be from February 27 to March 4 and the flats will put for sale on March 6.

The spokesman said 85 percent of the units would be offered to buyers registered under their own names with only 15 percent of the units available for buyers registered under company name, a move to curb the recent hot property speculation.
